comment: Inklang style lexicon: three small closed axes (style, technique, color) plus open-vocabulary motif. `name` is the form the realizer emits in modifier position ('a fine line octopus'); aliases are accepted by the parser. technique 'machine' and color null are defaults the realizer omits. The robot is black-ink-only today: programs requesting a color the hardware cannot honor must fail validation loudly, never produce a lying caption. Each term's `prompt` is the fragment the generator folds into its image prompt when the term is requested.

american-traditional.name: american traditional
american-traditional.prompt: american traditional tattoo style, bold outlines, classic old school flash

neo-traditional.prompt: neo-traditional tattoo style, bold lines, ornate details
